notes: branch 1 ends at عبد الله بن يزيد: after ح the text writes only the second branch's names
«وزاد، جعفر والليث» is a remark that Ja'far and al-Layth added يزيد بن أبي حبيب; kept in the route, not split
«- المعنى -» and «- قال جعفر ابن جبر -» are editor glosses and left out
Abu Basra is in the scene; his words are not a chain link, so عبيد is the last link
